Carcinoma della mammella destra, immunof: Carcinoma of the right breast, triple-negative immunophenotype: high-density mass of about 1.5 cm in the lower quadrants, visible on CC and MLO (CMMD D2-0356)
Donna di 57 anni. Mammografia bilaterale: 57-year-old woman. Bilateral mammography in cranio-caudal (CC) and medio-lateral oblique (MLO) projections.
Descrivi la densità delle mammelle e il: Describe the breast density and the main finding, assign a BI-RADS category and indicate what to do.
Per descrivere una massa in mammografia:
To describe a mass on mammography, shape, margins and density matter. Margins are the most important feature: circumscribed for more than 75% suggests a benign lesion; obscured, microlobulated, indistinct or spiculated margins require biopsy.
Triple-negative carcinomas (without hormone receptors and without HER2) are deceptive: they are often round or oval high-density masses, with only partly indistinct margins and few calcifications, and on ultrasound they may show posterior enhancement. They grow fast and are common among interval cancers and in younger women.
A mass seen in two projections, with no counterpart in the contralateral breast and with non-circumscribed margins, is biopsied. In dense breasts (ACR C and D) ultrasound is added.
Margini non circoscritti = biopsia, anch: Non-circumscribed margins = biopsy, even if the mass is round.
Carcinoma maligno, immunofenotipo triplo: Malignant carcinoma, triple-negative immunophenotype (clinical data of the CMMD collection).
